title: Developer Builds Free ADHD Unblocker Tool Using Claude AI
summary: Ryan Park releases free ADHD productivity tool built with Claude Duet that helps users overcome focus blocks through guided multiple-choice questions.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Developer Ryan Park launched a free ADHD productivity tool built entirely with Claude Duet that helps users identify and overcome focus blocks.
- The tool uses multiple-choice questions to diagnose what is preventing users from deploying agents or completing tasks, then provides targeted guidance.
- Available immediately at ryanpark.ai/claude-skills, the unblocker demonstrates practical applications of Claude AI for personal productivity and neurodivergent support.


Developer Ryan Park has officially released a free ADHD productivity tool built entirely with Claude AI, designed to help users overcome focus blocks through guided questioning. Officially launched on November 23, 2026, the tool is now available at ryanpark.ai/claude-skills and uses Claude Duet to identify barriers preventing users from deploying agents or completing tasks. Park shared the launch on Hacker News, offering the tool freely to the community as a practical demonstration of Claude's capabilities for personal productivity.


## How the ADHD Unblocker Works


The tool operates by presenting users with multiple-choice questions designed to diagnose what is blocking their progress. Rather than offering generic productivity advice, the unblocker tailors its guidance based on specific responses about focus challenges, task complexity, and execution barriers. The integration with Claude Duet allows the tool to process user inputs and generate contextually relevant suggestions for moving forward with agent deployment or task completion.


Park describes the tool as something that has personally helped him maintain focus and productivity when working with AI agents. The structured question-and-answer format provides a systematic approach to identifying and addressing the cognitive friction that often derails ADHD individuals during complex technical workflows.


## Claude Duet Integration and Technical Implementation


The unblocker leverages Claude Duet, Anthropic's collaborative AI interface, as its underlying engine. This integration enables real-time processing of user responses and dynamic generation of follow-up questions based on detected patterns. The tool demonstrates how Claude's natural language understanding can be applied to mental health and productivity support beyond traditional chatbot applications.


By building on Claude's conversational capabilities, Park created a lightweight intervention system that requires no installation or setup. Users simply navigate to the web interface and begin answering questions, making the tool accessible to anyone who needs immediate focus support.


## Release Details and Availability


The ADHD unblocker is completely free to use and requires no account creation or payment. Park released the tool as an open resource for the ADHD and developer communities, emphasizing practical utility over monetization. The launch represents a growing trend of developers building specialized productivity tools using large language models for neurodivergent users.


The Hacker News community response will likely inform future iterations of the tool, with Park presumably monitoring feedback for feature requests and usability improvements. The tool is hosted at ryanpark.ai/claude-skills and accessible from any device with a web browser.


## What This Means


This launch highlights the expanding ecosystem of community-built applications leveraging Claude AI for specialized use cases beyond coding and content generation. The ADHD unblocker demonstrates how conversational AI can address cognitive and executive function challenges through structured interventions. For individuals with ADHD working in technical fields, tools like this provide immediate, stigma-free support during moments of task paralysis or decision fatigue. The free availability and minimal barrier to entry make it a valuable addition to the growing toolkit of AI-assisted productivity resources designed specifically for neurodivergent professionals.
